connectionTypes.sourceNote: SOURCED (secondary) — eb.billcalculator.in, P&ED Mizoram 'Commercial/Non-Domestic (LT)' category: flat ₹7.50/unit (not slabbed), fixed ₹120/kW/month. Directionally cross-checked against JERC's official (but now 11-year-stale) FY2014-15 tariff order (power.mizoram.gov.in), which shows Non-Domestic/Commercial LT as slabbed ₹3.30/₹4.30/₹5.20 per kWh with fixed ₹50/kW — same 'commercial costs more than domestic' ordering holds, but no current (c.2025) primary JERC/P&ED tariff order was found to verify the exact rate. Pending primary-source verification.

SOURCED (secondary) — eb.billcalculator.in, P&ED Mizoram 'Small Industrial Power (LT)' category: flat ₹6.00/unit (not slabbed), fixed ₹90/kW/month. Directionally cross-checked against JERC's official (but now 11-year-stale) FY2014-15 tariff order (power.mizoram.gov.in), which shows Industrial LT as slabbed ₹3.45/₹4.10 per kWh with fixed ₹50/kW — same relative ordering (industrial below commercial) holds, but no current (c.2025) primary JERC/P&ED tariff order was found to verify the exact rate. Pending primary-source verification.
